# Getting Started

## Definitions

- **Scene Ref**: A `SceneRefSO` asset that represents an actual [`SceneAsset`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/SceneAsset.html) in a project.

## Create a *Scene Ref*

Right-click on a [`SceneAsset`](https://docs.unity3d.com/ScriptReference/SceneAsset.html) in the project, and go to `Create > Sideways Experiments > Scene Ref Asset` to create a *Scene Ref*.

*Scene Refs* can also be automatically generated, by enabling the option at `Edit > Project Settings > Sideways Experiments > Scene Refs > Auto Generate Scene Refs`.
